bio.text: Randall Terry is an independent candidate for Virginia's 7th Congressional District in the 2026 general election.
The New Jersey Globe describes him as the founder of the anti-abortion group Operation Rescue and the Constitution Party's presidential nominee two years before 2026.

sources.title: Anti-abortion leader Randall Terry ends independent House bid in NJ-7 - New Jersey Globe
